COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

2. Which statement about Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship.
   B. Explain Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Say Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Support Systems.
   B. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Support Systems as rumours only.
   D. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Making Important Choices is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Making Important Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Making Important Choices as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices.
   D. Say Making Important Choices never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup.
   B. Say Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.
   C. Treat Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 as rumours only.
   D. Explain Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Problem Validation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation.
   B. Say Problem Validation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Problem Validation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Problem Validation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

11. Which statement about Building Resilience is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience.
   B. Say Building Resilience never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Building Resilience as rumours only.
   D. Explain Building Resilience with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  as rumours only.
   B. Say Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action .
   D. Explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Advocacy in the Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
